Soft pieces

Banana pancakes

Banános babacsinta

6 months+ Sound idea 15 min 2 portions

Break into mashable pieces or mash the serving for a 6-month-old. Leave them unsweetened.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 medium ripe banana (mashed smooth)
  • 1 egg (cooked through)
  • 1 tbsp plain wheat flour (about 10 g)
  • 1 tsp olive oil (thin film in the pan)

Allergens

egggluten

Method

  1. Mash the banana until smooth.
  2. Beat in the egg and the flour, and add no sugar.
  3. Heat a thin film of oil on low heat.
  4. Cook small pancakes until the underside is set, then turn them.
  5. Cook until the egg is fully set in the center, then mash or break them for the baby.

Sound idea

Ripe banana, egg, and a little flour are already a plain batter, with no need for sugar. The pancake is a problem only if the center stays raw or the round is too thick to mash.

No ingredient change is needed. Cook small pancakes in a thin film of oil on low heat until the egg is fully set, and do not add sugar.
